newsitem.title: MACAU: Portuguese president's visit to China still on.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese president's visit to China still on.

text.p: Portuguese President Jorge Sampaio's visit to China next week will proceed irrespective of the health of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, a Chinese official in Macau said on Tuesday.

"It will go ahead definitely, irrespective of the state of health of Deng Xiaoping at that time," the official said shortly before Sampaio arrived in Portuguese-run Macau on Tuesday for a six-day visit.
Sampaio is scheduled to then travel on to China for an eight-day state visit.
